texts.zh:
我们现在准备开始这项史诗工程，环绕[From.From.GetName]星系的恒星来建造未来环形世界的初始框架。

这个框架所需的资源与矿物是史无前例的，我们成百上千最优秀的工程师准备好开始拆解恒星系内的行星，将这些物质用于环形世界建造。
texts.en:
We are now ready to begin the colossal task of building the initial frame of our future Ring World around the primary star of the [From.From.GetName] system.

The amount of resources and materials required to build this skeletal frame will be immense, and hundreds of thousands of our finest engineers stand ready to begin the process of dismantling the system's planetary bodies into matter which can be used in its construction.

label.zh: 我们正在创造历史。
label.en: We are making history.

label.zh: 升级后：骨架框架建成（ring_world_2_intermediate）
label.en: After the next upgrade: Skeletal frame built (ring_world_2_intermediate)

label.zh: 建造骨架时：与你有通讯并有经济/科技情报的玩家帝国收到通知（隐藏事件2001）
label.en: While the skeleton is being built: human empires with communications/intel get a notice (hidden 2001)

notes.zh: 审阅说明：环形世界每完成一个建造阶段，由 on_megastructure_built / on_megastructure_upgraded 在建造国触发对应事件（并非选项链接）；各阶段按建造顺序排列。完工后，隐藏事件 utopia.2006 在5天后设置国家标记 finished_ringworld，之后的废墟事件按此标记换选项。
notes.en: Review note: each build stage of the Ring World fires its own event for the builder from on_megastructure_built / on_megastructure_upgraded (not option links); stages are shown in construction order. After completion hidden utopia.2006 sets the country flag finished_ringworld 5 days later; the ruin event uses it to pick its option.

texts.zh:
我们在[From.From.GetName]星系建设的环形世界框架现以完成。虽然还有很多后续工作，这个周长近十亿千米的金属骨架的完成必将是工程界的一项壮举。

我们准备好建设真正意义上的宜居地了。
texts.en:
The skeletal frame of the Ring World we are building in the [From.From.GetName] system has finally been completed. Although there is still much left to do, the mere completion of this metal skeleton, which has a circumference of nearly a billion kilometers, must be considered an incredible feat of engineering.

We are now ready to start work on creating the actual habitats.

label.zh: 还有许多工作等着我们。
label.en: Much work lies before us.

label.zh: 升级后：环形世界完工（ring_world_3_intermediate，且星系内已无 ring_world_2）
label.en: After the next upgrade: Ring World completed (ring_world_3_intermediate, no ring_world_2 left in the system)

texts.zh:
今天，我们的工程师和行星生态学家完成了位于[completed_ringworld_system.GetName]星系的环形世界最后一个宜居区间的建造。这个伟大的巨型结构的建造必将成为[Root.GetName]历史的里程碑。我们完成了屈指可数的文明才能完成的工作。

让这个环形世界成为一个永恒的见证：自从[Root.GetSpeciesName]物种从安全的母星踏足至如今，我们达成了什么样的成就。
texts.en:
Our engineers and planetary ecologists today finished the last of the habitat sections on the Ring World we built in the [completed_ringworld_system.GetName] system. The construction of this great megastructure must be considered a milestone in the history of the [Root.GetName] - we have accomplished what only a handful of civilizations in the history of our galaxy has managed before.

Let this Ring World stand forever as a testament to how much the [Root.GetSpeciesName] species has achieved since we first ventured beyond the safety of our homeworld's atmosphere.

texts.zh:
我们完成了位于[completed_ringworld_system.GetName]恒星系的环形世界宜居区间的建造，我们的工程师和生态学家又一次完成了不可能。

[Root.GetName]将被认为是全星系历史中最伟大的造匠之一。
texts.en:
We have concluded work on the habitat sections of the Ring World we built in the [completed_ringworld_system.GetName] system. Our engineers and ecologists have accomplished the impossible yet again.

The [Root.GetName] must now truly be considered one of the greatest builders in the history of the galaxy.

label.zh: 这是伟大的一天。
label.en: This is a great day.

label.zh: 完工时：同样条件的玩家帝国收到通知
label.en: On completion: human empires with intel get a notice

texts.zh:
[From.GetName]完成了历史上屈指可数的文明才能完成的壮举——他们完成了位于[completed_ringworld_system.GetName]星系的巨型环形世界的建造。

这项科学奇迹将成为[From.GetSpeciesName]物种那举世瞩目的奇迹的见证，从默默无闻的开始以来他们一路走过了很久。
texts.en:
The [From.GetName] has accomplished what only a handful of civilizations in the history of our galaxy has managed before - they have finished construction of the colossal Ring World they were building around the primary star of the [completed_ringworld_system.GetName] system.

This technological marvel must be considered a testament to the impressive achievements of the [From.GetSpeciesName] species as a whole. They have certainly come a long way from their humble beginnings.

texts.zh: [From.GetName]完成了又一个环形世界的建造！这个壮观的巨型结构坐落在[completed_ringworld_system.GetName]星系，曾经这个星系的行星都以不见踪影，它们被拆解为建造用料。
texts.en: The [From.GetName] has finished another Ring World! This massive megastructure is located in the [completed_ringworld_system.GetName] system, which is now devoid of other planetary bodies since those that once existed were dismantled and used as building material.

label.zh: 也许我们也要考虑再建一些。
label.en: Perhaps we should consider building more as well.

label.zh: 又有一个？他们的资源用不完的吗？
label.en: Another one? Is there no limit to their resources?

texts.zh: 我们收到消息[From.GetName]已着手在[ringworld_system.GetName]星系建造一个史诗级项目。他们旨在建造一个巨大的环形世界以环绕恒星系的恒星，作为项目的第一步他们开始将星系所有行星转换为巨型结构的金属骨架。
texts.en: Word has reached us that the [From.GetName] has undertaken a construction project of monumental proportions in the [ringworld_system.GetName] system. They intend to build a massive Ring World around the system's primary, and as a first step they have started to convert the matter of all nearby planetary bodies into an initial metal skeleton for the megastructure.

texts.zh: 我们收到消息[From.GetName]开始建造另一个环形世界，这次是在[ringworld_system.GetName]星系！和以前一样他们的工程师正在拆解星系的所有行星，用他们的资源和材料进行环形世界建造。
texts.en: We have received intelligence that the [From.GetName] is about to start construction on yet another Ring World, this time in the [ringworld_system.GetName] system! As before, their engineers are currently in the process of dismantling all planetary bodies in the system so that their resources and materials can be used in the Ring World's construction.

label.zh: 那个环会和我们的一样壮观吗？
label.en: Will it be as impressive as our own?

label.zh: 一项壮举，如果能完成的话。
label.en: An impressive project... if it is ever finished.

texts.zh:
这些环绕着[ring_system.GetName]星系中央恒星的残骸，来自一个古老的环形世界。任何曾经存在于这个恒星系的行星体，都在这个庞然大物的修建工程中被作为建筑材料而使用。

没有证据能够指明这个工程奇迹最初是被谁修建的，但这一定是一个高度先进文明的杰作。
texts.en:
The shattered remnants of an ancient Ring World encircle the star of the [ring_system.GetName] system. Any planetary bodies that may once have existed here must have been used as building material during this megastructure's construction.

No evidence hinting towards who originally built this marvel of engineering has been found, but it must have been the product of a very advanced culture.

label.zh: 至少他们和我们的文明一样先进。
label.en: As advanced as we are, at any rate.

label.zh: 令人惊讶。
label.en: Amazing.

label.zh: 修复废墟（建造“修复”型巨型结构）后
label.en: After the ruin is restored (the "restored" megastructure type is built over it)

notes.zh: 审阅说明：废墟是地图上预置的，不属于任何建造阶段；首次进入该星系时由 on_entering_system_first_time 触发。
notes.en: Review note: the ruin is a pre-placed map object, not a build stage; on_entering_system_first_time fires this event the first time a ship enters the system.

texts.zh: 基于[From.GetName]星系的环形世界废墟，我们的工程师成功地将它的一个区段恢复运转。全新的环形世界生态结构几乎是由我们的行星学家从零开始规划，但现在它已经足够稳定，可以居住了。
texts.en: Building on what remains of the ruined Ring World in the [From.GetName] system, our engineers have managed to fully restore one of its sections. The new biosphere had to be created more or less from scratch by our leading planetologists, but it is now considered stable and ready for habitation.

label.zh: 棒极了。
label.en: Excellent.

summary.text:
# 环形世界 / Ring World

- 分类 Category：银河轶事 C8 stories · 来源 Sources：events/megastructure_events_1.txt、common/megastructures/00_ring_world.txt、common/on_actions/00_on_actions.txt（on_megastructure_built / on_megastructure_upgraded / on_entering_system_first_time）· DLC：Utopia（按本地化文件名）· 审阅 Reviewed 2026-10-13

## 如何开始 How it starts

在你自己的边境内放置并开工环形世界（见 common/megastructures/00_ring_world.txt）。每个建造阶段完工时，巨型结构的 on_build_complete 或 on_megastructure_upgraded 触发对应的国家事件；这些事件只是阶段提示，没有选择分支（每个只有一个“确认”选项）。
You place and start a Ring World inside your borders (common/megastructures/00_ring_world.txt). Every completed build stage fires a country event for the builder; these are stage notices with a single confirm option, no branching.

## 剧情脉络 Story outline

1. utopia.2000：环形世界基址建成（ring_world_1） / Ring World site built (ring_world_1)
2. utopia.2003：骨架框架建成（ring_world_2_intermediate） / Skeletal frame built (ring_world_2_intermediate)
3. utopia.2004：环形世界完工（ring_world_3_intermediate，且星系内已无 ring_world_2） / Ring World completed (ring_world_3_intermediate, no ring_world_2 left in the system)

按顺序出现，由建造进度决定，不由事件编号决定。 They appear in construction order, driven by build progress rather than by event id.

## 分支与结局 Branches and outcomes

- 其他帝国的通知 Notices to other empires：
- utopia.2002：建造骨架时：与你有通讯并有经济/科技情报的玩家帝国收到通知（隐藏事件2001） / While the skeleton is being built: human empires with communications/intel get a notice (hidden 2001)
- utopia.2005：完工时：同样条件的玩家帝国收到通知 / On completion: human empires with intel get a notice
- 废墟 The ruin：utopia.2016（星系首次进入时，需该星系的星标记“ruined_ring_system”）可以选择“与我们的相近”（已拥有同类）或“很迷人”（没有同类时，30天后进入通用跟进事件 story.5）；utopia.2017 在修复完成后出现。
  utopia.2016 fires when a ship first enters the system; the option depends on whether you already own this megastructure ("fascinating" otherwise, which fires the generic follow-up story.5 after 30 days). utopia.2017 fires when the ruin is restored.
- 没有随机或互斥分支，只有“建造阶段”与“废墟/修复”两条独立线索。 No random or exclusive branches: two independent threads (build stages; ruin and restoration).

## 条件与文明差异 Conditions and variants

- 建造阶段事件仅发给建造国；通知事件发给满足通讯与情报条件的其他非AI国家。 Stage events go to the builder only; notices go to other non-AI countries that meet the communication/intel condition.
- 完工后，隐藏事件 utopia.2006 在5天后设置国家标记 finished_ringworld，之后的废墟事件按此标记换选项。 After completion hidden utopia.2006 sets the country flag finished_ringworld 5 days later; the ruin event uses it to pick its option.

## 审阅记录 Review notes

- 已核对 Checked：common/megastructures/00_ring_world.txt 各阶段 on_build_complete，common/on_actions/00_on_actions.txt 的 on_megastructure_* 与 on_entering_system_first_time 列表，events/megastructure_events_1.txt 中各事件的 trigger/option。
- 更正 Corrections：原先每个阶段、通知与废墟事件各自成为一个单页故事；现合并为同一巨型结构的故事，阶段按建造顺序连接。 Previously every stage, notice and ruin event was its own one-card story; they are merged and ordered by construction.
- 不确定 Uncertain：废墟如何被放置（星系初始化器/事件的星标记）未逐一追踪。 How ruins are placed on the map (system initializers / star flags) was not traced one by one.
